title.value: Draft and publish blog posts with an SEO-aware agent

introduction.value: An author's OpenClaw agent learns his voice, finds SEO gaps, drafts posts, publishes on his Telegram approval and drafts revision briefs when rankings drop.

method.value: Chudi Nnorukam runs OpenClaw as five coordinated skills. It builds a voice profile from his existing posts and polls Google Search Console weekly for ranking opportunities. It drafts a post in his voice and rewrites any section that scores below 0.7 on voice consistency. After he replies PUBLISH on Telegram, it builds, commits, pushes and requests indexing.

outcome.value: The post describes the design and a sample Telegram exchange, not measured ranking or traffic results. He claims three posts ship over a weekend, against one every 10-14 days manually.

notes.value: A full draft costs roughly $0.20-0.40 with Claude Sonnet; he suggests about three days of setup and keeping human approval before any git push.

source_text.body:
Draft and publish blog posts with an SEO-aware agent
An author's OpenClaw agent learns his voice, finds SEO gaps, drafts posts, publishes on his Telegram approval and drafts revision briefs when rankings drop.
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
Chudi Nnorukam runs OpenClaw as five coordinated skills. It builds a voice profile from his existing posts and polls Google Search Console weekly for ranking opportunities. It drafts a post in his voice and rewrites any section that scores below 0.7 on voice consistency. After he replies PUBLISH on Telegram, it builds, commits, pushes and requests indexing.
How it went
The post describes the design and a sample Telegram exchange, not measured ranking or traffic results. He claims three posts ship over a weekend, against one every 10-14 days manually.
Worth knowing
A full draft costs roughly $0.20-0.40 with Claude Sonnet; he suggests about three days of setup and keeping human approval before any git push.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Learn my writing voice from these posts: [URLs or folder]. Then find [5] SEO gaps for my site [domain] on the topic of [topic] and draft one post for the best one. Send the draft to me on [Telegram] and wait for my approval before publishing anything to [CMS].
Original source: https://chudi.dev/blog/openclaw-autonomous-blog-agent
